verdict.rationale: The evidence never says Meltano loaders write typed, deduplicated tables. The closest support is that transformations run through dbt (meltano-docs-6, meltano-docs-11), which implies typing and dedup are left to user-built dbt models, plus stream/property selection and incremental state tracking (meltano-docs-19, meltano-docs-20). Missing for 10: documented typed-column landing by loaders, primary-key dedup/upsert behavior on load, handling of nested JSON versus flattened columns, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
